# Context actions block

## Fields {#fields}

Field

Type

Description

Required?

`type`

String

The type of block. For a context actions block, `type` is always `context_actions`.

Required

`elements`

Object\[\]

An array of [feedback buttons elements](https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit/block-elements/feedback-buttons-element) and [icon button elements](https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit/block-elements/icon-button-element). Maximum number of items is 5.

Required

`block_id`

String

A unique identifier for a block. You can use this `block_id` when you receive an interaction payload to [identify the source of the action](https://docs.slack.dev/interactivity/handling-user-interaction#payloads). If not specified, `block_id` will be generated. Maximum length for this field is 255 characters. `block_id` should be unique for each message and each iteration of a message. If a message is updated, use a new `block_id`.

Optional
